verses.english: Linked Discourses 54.6
1. One Thing
With Ariṭṭha
At Sāvatthī.
There the Buddha … said:
“Mendicants, do you develop mindfulness of breathing?”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā ariṭṭho bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, Venerable Ariṭṭha said to him:
“Sir, I develop mindfulness of breathing.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, ariṭṭha, bhāvesi ānāpānassatin”ti?
verses.english: “But mendicant, how do you develop it?”

verses.pali: “Atītesu me, bhante, kāmesu kāmacchando pahīno, anāgatesu me kāmesu kāmacchando vigato, ajjhattabahiddhā ca me dhammesu paṭighasaññā suppaṭivinītā.
verses.english: “Sir, I’ve given up desire for sensual pleasures of the past. I’m rid of desire for sensual pleasures of the future. And I have eliminated perception of aversion regarding phenomena internally and externally.
Just mindful, I will breathe in. Mindful, I will breathe out.
That’s how I develop mindfulness of breathing.”
“That is mindfulness of breathing, Ariṭṭha; I don’t deny it.

verses.pali: Api ca, ariṭṭha, yathā ānāpānassati vitthārena paripuṇṇā hoti
verses.english: But as to how mindfulness of breathing is fulfilled in detail,

verses.pali: taṁ suṇāhi, sādhukaṁ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ariṭṭho bhagavato paccassosi.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” Ariṭṭha replied.
The Buddha said this:
“And how is mindfulness of breathing fulfilled in detail?

verses.pali: Idha, ariṭṭha, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṁ ābhujitvā ujuṁ kāyaṁ paṇidhāya parimukhaṁ satiṁ upaṭṭhapetvā.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant—gone to a wilderness, or to the root of a tree, or to an empty hut—sits down cross-legged, sets their body straight, and brings mindfulness to the present.
Just mindful, they breathe in. Mindful, they breathe out.
Breathing in heavily they know: ‘I’m breathing in heavily.’ Breathing out heavily they know: ‘I’m breathing out heavily.’ …
They practice like this: ‘I’ll breathe in observing letting go.’ They practice like this: ‘I’ll breathe out observing letting go.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, ariṭṭha, ānāpānassati vitthārena paripuṇṇā hotī”ti.
verses.english: This is how mindfulness of breathing is fulfilled in detail.”
